operating_notes.text: Unibild Engineering and Construction Co. Pvt. Ltd. held 62,40,000 Unitech shares as on 31 March 2026, all unencumbered but marked 'Suspended for Debit' in its demat account since 31 December 2018.
Praveen Gurnani held 42,75,310 Unitech shares as on 31 March 2026, nil encumbered but marked 'Suspended for Debit' since 31 December 2018, seeking reclassification before the Supreme Court.
Resolution Framework filed by the new management is still pending approval from the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
Company has 2,431 litigations pending in the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
Public deposits amounting to ₹529.13 Cr are overdue for repayment, with unaccounted interest of ₹612.35 Cr.
CFO Tajinder Pal Singh Madan resigned effective close of 29 May 2026, citing relocation out of Gurugram for personal reasons; no successor named.

timeline.summary: Unibild Engineering and Construction declared 62,40,000 Unitech shares (nil encumbrance) as on 31 March 2026 and renewed its demand, under protest, to be reclassified from promoter group to public.
Praveen Gurnani disclosed 42,75,310 unencumbered shares under Reg 31(4) under protest, pursuing reclassification before the Supreme Court.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹130.22 Cr, net loss to shareholders ₹441.08 Cr (against a loss of ₹309.96 Cr a year earlier).
2026-05-30: Board accepted the resignation of CFO Tajinder Pal Singh Madan effective close of 29 May 2026, citing his move out of Gurugram for personal reasons.

status_history.evidence: Praveen Gurnani confirmed his reclassification applications (IA no.298073/2024 and 297931/2024) remain pending before the Supreme Court.

watchlist.text: Supreme Court directions on the reclassification applications
Supreme Court approval of the Resolution Framework
